stage.title: Late completion and MMSCH state
stage.next_evidence: Trace context, final image status, late SVC returns, state[19], buffer-helper result and final completion result together.

claims.title: Type-13 completion requests the late management write after loader success
claims.scope: Host-context sentinel ffff selects 0900c004 <- 1; then 1f8a4 <- 1. SVC statuses can be discarded. Not proof of reset release.

claims.title: Final nonzero image status skips ordinary type-13 completion writes
claims.scope: 26 raw instruction/branch checks tie image error to omitted 0900c004 / 1f8a4 requests. Other writers and physical reset semantics remain open.

claims.title: Late-write context is traced back to the t02 ring worker
claims.scope: Worker literal 0000FFFF travels through message+44 to type-13 completion. It is request context, not hardware readiness; FFFFFFFF does not satisfy the full equality.

claims.title: VCN reads MMSCH state[19] after the late writes
claims.scope: Nonzero state[19] suppresses the mapped-buffer helper error after the writes. VCN marks slot 13; RLC uses 21/22. This is bookkeeping, not established hardware-ready state.

claims.title: Five late PSP registers are captured runtime state for replay
claims.scope: 1F8C4..1F8D4 values are captured and restored. Initial zero words are not established cold-start constants; write requests do not establish accepted stores.
